app.core.config module¶

app.core.security module¶

Security and authentication utilities.

This module provides helper functions and configurations related to authentication, password handling, JWT token generation, and basic amount validation used across the API.

JWT signing algorithm.

Create a JWT access token.

app.core.security.hash_password(password: str) → str[source]¶

Hash a plaintext password.

password (str) – Plaintext password.
